cases.name: Dalana Elisa Charlot
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Dalana had a deep love for life and adventure. She especially enjoyed traveling and going on cruises, always looking forward to her next journey and the memories it would bring. She had a special gift for bringing people together and took great joy in organizing family gatherings and events, ensuring that every moment spent together was meaningful and filled with laughter.

She also found happiness in shopping, but more than anything, she treasured the time she spent with her family and friends. Dalana was known for her warm spirit, her caring heart, and her ability to make those around her feel loved and valued.

Above all, Dalana was a devoted and wonderful mother. Her children were the center of her world, and she loved them more than anything. Her unconditional love, guidance, and strength will forever live on in their hearts."
